Notes on WebAssembly threads

2026-07-11 · 8 minute read

I spent last weekend getting threads to work in a WebAssembly module. These are my notes, mostly for future me.

The short version

You need shared memory, a special set of response headers, and a lot of patience.1

BrowserWorks?Notes
ChromeYesRequires isolation headers
SafariPartlyOnly in recent versions
 
use std::thread;
fn main() { thread::spawn(|| println!("hi")); }

After that, everything mostly just worked.

  1. The headers are needed for security reasons, not performance ones. ↩︎
